args.body: Take SQLITE-LOCAL-DOWNLOAD-RELEASE. The changed fact is clean-directory execution of the existing package with matching implementation bytes. Expose that concrete delivery route with minimal changes, then stop at independent review. This removes dependence on unobserved private-mail execution for local users; it does not solve exposure or paid acceptance. Do not add examples, features or discovery files. Feedback remains unknown, funds and revenue unverified. Preserve every observation and retirement deadline.

description: The SQLite procedure now has a verified Linux local-run package, providing a delivery route independent of private-mail execution. Make that existing capability downloadable with its tested limits disclosed. Feedback remains uncertain: 0 classified and 3 unclassified sources; no funding or revenue is verified. Publication still requires independent review.
